remainingOwnerCommands.purpose: Allow the deployer to read and upload the staging API image to the exact staging repository.
Create or confirm the exact staging API runtime service account.
remainingOwnerCommands.command: gcloud iam service-accounts create reeditpro-api-staging --project=reeditpro --display-name='ReEditPro API staging runtime'
remainingOwnerCommands.alreadyExistsAlternative: If an owner has already created this service account, do not recreate it; run gcloud iam service-accounts describe reeditpro-api-staging@reeditpro.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=reeditpro instead.

remainingOwnerCommands.purpose: Allow the deployer to deploy Cloud Run with the exact staging runtime service account.
Allow the deployer to describe only the fixed staging API Secret Manager entries without granting secret payload access.
remainingOwnerCommands.target: fixed staging API Secret Manager entries only
remainingOwnerCommands.commandTemplate: for secret in <fixed-staging-api-secret-name-1> <fixed-staging-api-secret-name-2> <fixed-staging-api-secret-name-3> <fixed-staging-api-secret-name-4>; do gcloud secrets add-iam-policy-binding "$secret" --project=reeditpro --member=serviceAccount:sa-remotion-render-worker@reeditpro.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/secretmanager.viewer; done

remainingOwnerCommands.purpose: Allow the staging API runtime account to access only the fixed staging API secret payloads after deploy.
remainingOwnerCommands.target: fixed staging API Secret Manager entries only
remainingOwnerCommands.commandTemplate: for secret in <fixed-staging-api-secret-name-1> <fixed-staging-api-secret-name-2> <fixed-staging-api-secret-name-3> <fixed-staging-api-secret-name-4>; do gcloud secrets add-iam-policy-binding "$secret" --project=reeditpro --member=serviceAccount:reeditpro-api-staging@reeditpro.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor; done
expectedAuditProof: runtime secret access is not claimed by the read-only audit and must be proven by deploy/runtime evidence

blockedAlternatives: granting secret payload access to the deployer
Cloud Run deploy before audit passes
Docker build or Artifact Registry push before audit passes
external beta or production enablement before deployed evidence and owner approvals
postOwnerValidation: rerun .github/workflows/beta-readiness-api-staging-input-discovery.yml with READ_STAGING_BETA_API_DEPLOY_INPUTS and exact staging inputs
only after both read-only workflows pass, dispatch .github/workflows/beta-readiness-api-staging-deploy.yml with DEPLOY_STAGING_BETA_READINESS_API, an immutable image tag, and exact source SHA
